warning_classification: Godot 4.7 OutputError payload[9] boolean warning; raw packets retained; malformed packets remain errors

definitions.self: Raw Godot4.7 script function self_time. Ordinary script calls are subtracted; inherited super calls are not subtracted by OPCODE_CALL_SELF_BASE. Native work may be inside self when native call profiling is off. Inheritance chain rows overlap and must not be summed.
definitions.native_calls: With native profiling ON, instrumented native call time is subtracted from the direct script caller SELF. Inherited super calls remain unsubtracted; raw inheritance-chain SELF rows still overlap. Native time aggregates by NativeClass.method across script callers; retained path does not identify the caller. Not every native/property/engine task is instrumented. Debug profiler overhead is not release performance.
definitions.internal: Raw Godot internal_time is retained for auditing; native collation changes its per-script attribution, so do not use it as a per-caller native budget or add it to SELF/native totals.
definitions.per_frame: Total callback self milliseconds divided by captured process frames; physics calls are not normalized per physics tick.
definitions.boundaries: Only process frame numbers strictly inside fixed route start/end; both boundary frames excluded.
